title: Paris-based Remanence, which helps companies train and fine-tune open-weight AI models, raised a $30M seed led by EQT Ventures and FirstMark (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios: Paris-based Remanence, which helps companies train and fine-tune open-weight AI models, raised a $30M seed led by EQT Ventures and FirstMark — Remanence, a startup helping companies train their own AI models using open-weight players, raised $30 million in seed funding led by EQT Ventures and FirstMark …
